scope: Exposed development diagnostic of clinical-label feasibility; finish the previously unexecuted reported-results input step for the same twelve origin-frozen trials.
membership: All original twelve trials, no result-presence, event-date, status, p-value or favorable-evidence selection; all missing and held source versions retained.
result_scope: Retain raw titles, timeframes, population, arm/group identity, counts, units, missingness, analysis methods, raw/parsed effects, confidence intervals and p-value qualifiers. Planned outcomes remain separate.
temporal_policy: Unchanged DATE-offset eligibility; current version last-update posting must qualify by ascertainment and not postdate its source snapshot. Held payloads stay quarantined. First result posting does not backdate the full result version.
interpretation: Result presence, nominal significance, completion, enrollment and publication dates do not by themselves establish clinical success/failure, experimental first dosing or next-phase advancement.
review: Independently inspect retained rows and source locators against planned objectives. Preserve the old36 unresolved labels unless a separately documented adjudication with every original gate qualifies; no gate waiver or endpoint substitution in this diagnostic.
source_recovery: At most two additional primary documents per original trial; exact publication/version eligibility and access depth required; no favorable-result expansion.
execution: Exact deterministic read-only SQL pinned before dispatch, two identical reads, original restored-source proofs, owned server lifecycle, explicit linkage and missingness checks, durable failures and fresh output directories. No automatic retry.
selection_exposure: Original clinical metadata and prior adjudications already exposed; this is not an untouched held-out, prospectively preregistered or locked clinical evaluation.
scope_of_completion: Retained reported-result coverage, contract corrections and label-readiness decision; cohort/predictor/power/scoring qualification remains separate.
